$comment: Non-regression budgets (specs/031-non-regression-budgets). tools/budget.mjs compares a head tree with its base on one runner. Change a budget only with a reason in the PR; a one-off cost belongs in a Budget-Exempt line instead. The MCP guard response is measured on a fixed fixture: on this repository its size follows the branch's own findings (commit-count and diff heuristics), not the output format.
